changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Other:Text-to-SQL Parsing' as it's not a generation task, normalized BERT to BERT-Large (specified in implementation details), and clarified that parsing is actually generation
Normalized all variations to 'Exact Match Accuracy' using standard capitalization
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in this paper

guideline: Annotators were shown a paragraph description of the database, table names, column descriptions and ten sampled rows for each table. They were asked to avoid using exact phrases from the column headings in the questions.

changes_made.explanation: Removed the guideline because it describes dataset creation annotation, not human evaluation of generated outputs. The paper does not conduct human evaluation of the SQL queries generated by the models.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on text-to-SQL generation evaluation using automatic metrics. While humans were involved in dataset creation, there was no human evaluation of the model outputs. The main contribution is the KaggleDBQA dataset and evaluation methodology for realistic text-to-SQL parsing.
